company.name: FalconViz
company.shortDescription: Falconviz provides end-to-end asset digitization to process digitalization services utilizing UAVs and related equipment.
company.description: FalconViz is set to deliver digital transformation at scale in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabis. As an intelligence company founded in patented technological advancements developed at KAUST from 2014, we are the kingdom’s experts in developing state-of-the-art solutions to rapidly digitize invaluable assets across geospatial, inspection, climate and cultural heritage market sectors. We uniquely are able to fill the technological gaps of digital transformation through the deployment of our fleet of aerial drones, terrestrial scanning systems, cyber-secure data center and team of specialized geo-engineers and spatial computing experts. By providing turn-key AI and software solutions, we extract intelligence from our clients’ digitized assets enabling them to advance their digitization and intelligence capabilities and make strategic decisions in real-time.
